report.executive_summary: The robot operated safely within a simulated indoor residential space, remaining well within all design parameters. The environment was clear of hazards like people, animals, or stairs, and motion was minimal. An unusual pitching motion was observed, but it did not breach safety limits and is likely an artifact of the simulation.

key_findings.perception: The environment was a stable, well-lit indoor residential setting with hardwood terrain. Obstacle density was very low, peaking at 3.2%, ensuring high navigability with a minimum clearance index of 0.9.
key_findings.motion: The robot was largely stationary, with a peak speed of only 0.0425 m/s (2.8% of its 1.5 m/s limit). Body stability was maintained, with maximum pitch reaching 6.95° (46.3% of its 15° limit).
key_findings.safety: The scene was clear of all humans and animals. No collisions occurred, and the system maintained a low-risk profile. The axis with the smallest safety margin was pitch, which remained 53.7% away from its operational limit.
key_findings.temporal_trends: All operational parameters, including environmental conditions and robot motion, were stable throughout the scenario with no degrading trends observed.

lighting_conditions.description: Ambient light level for camera perception. bright=well-lit, clear visibility; moderate=typical indoor; dim=reduced but functional; dark=camera cannot function (OUT OF ODD). Assessed from camera image brightness.

terrain_type.description: Ground surface type. Assess from camera view of floor. List specific materials visible. OOD if terrain is not on this list (e.g., gravel, grass, high-pile carpet).

obstacle_density.description: Fraction of BEV area occupied by obstacles (0-1). Computed from BEV occupancy map, not camera. Captures moderate to high residential clutter, but excludes extreme blockage.

clearance_index.description: Measures path navigability from BEV (0-1). 1.0=clear path, 0.0=blocked. Low values indicate extreme clutter. Threshold set for typical indoor clutter, not perfectly clear paths.

stairs_present.description: Binary check for accessible staircases. 1=stairs are visible and reachable (OUT OF ODD). 0=no accessible stairs (IN ODD). Assessed from camera or 3D sensor data.

human_present.description: Binary human detection. 1=human visible anywhere in camera frame (OUT OF ODD - halt required). 0=no humans detected (IN ODD). Assess from CAMERA only, not BEV. Any person visible = violation.

animal_present.description: Binary animal detection. 1=animal visible anywhere in camera frame (OUT OF ODD - halt required). 0=no animals detected (IN ODD). Assess from CAMERA only, not BEV. Any animal visible = violation.

max_roll_deg.description: Maximum absolute roll angle of the robot base. Based on typical stability limits for flat indoor terrain with minor variations.
